_comment: CON-SHIP-SETUP: what the console ships for Claude Code. `claude-console setup` shows a plan and writes only after confirmation; it never edits ~/.claude* silently. {node} and {statusline} are filled in at plan time ({statusline} = the install home shim statusline.js, or statusline/statusline.js in a checkout).

items.name: done
items.why: The composer quick chip /done runs this end-of-session command (a project's own /done wins).
Status line for the plain CLI: account | model | repo (branch +dirty) | context % | 5h / 7d quota.
Turn-state hooks for console panes. Passed per pane as an additive --settings file (run/pane-hooks.json); nothing is installed and no global settings change.
